content: Bepaŋ kubugoŋdi mapme loloŋnit ilaŋa metam hogohogok yabudokolak
Hidi Yahwedok kap kobuli tomineŋ. Metam hogohogok kwetfoloŋ hatiiŋ hidi Yahwedok kap tomineŋ.
Yahwedi kotigoŋ ninigikuk. Unduŋ doktiŋa kap toŋa wou nintiloneŋ! Indi melenai tuwot indigoŋ wendok nadiŋa metam yenihautayaneem.
Hidi metam hogohogok wougigitŋiŋ yenihautaneŋ. Kwanai wapuhi momohi tuguk u metam hogohogok yenimbihitneŋ.
Yahwe adi wougigitnit. Unduŋ doktiŋa wou niŋatilone foloniŋgoŋ halek. Indi aditok hogok gikiŋgoŋ timiyaneem. Eŋ bepaŋ yalayalaŋ hekidok adi gikiŋgoŋ mu tiyemdok.
Bepaŋ yalayalaŋ metam noli’walaŋ woŋ adi bepaŋ biyagoŋ mooŋ. Yahwe ne kunum tiŋa nemenemek uŋoŋ hakiiŋ u yehitubu-mintaguk.
Yahwe adi wougigitnit tiŋa Mapme loloŋnit itak. Tiŋa adi yoli uŋgoniŋ hinek gineŋ uŋoŋ nemenemek hakiiŋdi adi’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ eŋ tinahukutŋiŋ beweniŋgoŋ u wendi yobihikiiŋ.
Metam kwetkwet hatiiŋ, hidi hogohogok saŋiniŋŋiŋ eŋ wougigitŋiŋ nintiloneŋ.
Hidi Yahwe wougigitŋiŋ nintiloneŋ. Tiŋa siloŋ timindok nemek neeŋ moŋgola Siloŋyotneŋ foneŋ.
Metam hogohogok kwetkwet hatiiŋ, hidi Yahwedok heheleeŋ Wapum Uŋgoniŋ, hauta holiholiŋenit hatilak, niutumbayaneeŋ.
Hidi metam hogohogok indiŋ yenineŋ, “Yahwe adi Mapme loloŋnit! Adigoŋ kwet tubufafaŋeune waliwali mu tiŋa hatak. Adi kougoŋ titiŋ didimeniŋ tiŋa metam hogohogok medehik nadiŋa yodapmawaak.”
Kunum kwet, hidi nadifo tidemek. Imeŋgwaŋ wapum tiŋa nemenemek imeŋgwaŋ maaneŋ hakiiŋ, hidi ime giyondaaŋ muhilaŋa mede tobune baham toneŋ.

Dinina tiŋa nemenemek dinina gineŋ uŋoŋ hakiiŋ hogohogok hidi nadifo tineŋ. Yahwe adi buŋa kwet wapum i kadokowaak doktiŋa bem heki behepneŋ yakiiŋ adi nadifo tiŋa kap toneeŋ. Yahwe adi metam hogohogok titiŋ didimeniŋ tiŋa yabudokowaak. Eŋ mede biyagoŋ hogok yoŋa mede nadinadi kwanai tibaak.
